create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for a given lmax and lmin
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels from lmin to lmax
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from Ra and Rb real and imaginary parts using precomputed coefficients
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform complex Wigner D matrices represented as real-pair into real spherical harmonic basis
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor into the real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb complex numbers
